title: Cloned value as an iterated expectation
statement: Let $E$ be a finite weighted constraint experiment, let $M>0$, and let $a$ assign values to variable-clone pairs. The value of the cloned experiment under $a$ equals the expectation over an outcome drawn from the original experiment of the uniform mean, over all clone choices for that outcome's query positions, of the cloned payoff.
hypotheses_covered: An assignment of values to variable-clone pairs is given
